questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: PROPITIOUS
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Favorable**.

• The word **"Propitious"** means something that is favorable, promising, or indicating a high likelihood of success. (अनुकूल)

• **"Favorable"** refers to conditions or circumstances that are advantageous or beneficial. (अनुकूल)
 
 
• **Example: **The team was given favorable odds of winning the championship.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Propitious' **is **'Favorable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Favorable**.

• **Example: ** Smoking is harmful to your health.
 
 
• **Unlucky** (अभाग्यशाली): Having bad luck or experiencing unfortunate events.
 
 
• **Example:** He was unlucky to miss the bus by just a few seconds.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.
She said, "My parents will arrive today."

options.text: She said that her parents will arrive that day.
She said her parents would arrive today.
She said that her parents would arrive that day.
She said her parents would be arriving today.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that her parents would arrive that day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"today" becomes "that day"**
 
 
• The adverb "today" is replaced with "that day" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"will arrive" becomes "would arrive"**
 
 
• The future tense "will" is changed to "would" to match the indirect speech format.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "She said,"
 
• Indirect: "She said that" is used to introduce the reported clause.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The sentence is written in a declarative structure.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said that her parents would arrive that day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said that her parents will arrive that day."
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "will" should be changed to "would" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "She said her parents would arrive today."
 
 
• Incorrect adverb: "today" should be replaced with "that day" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She said her parents would be arriving today."
 
 
• Incorrect adverb: "today" should be changed to "that day."
 
• The use of "would be arriving" is not as accurate as "would arrive" in this context.
 
 
</ul

• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“I wish to speak with the manager,” he said."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "I want to speak with the manager," he said. 
 
 
• The word "want" changes the tone and meaning, suggesting a stronger desire rather than a polite wish.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "I wished to speak with the manager," he said. 
 
 
• Tense is incorrect: "wished" implies past, whereas the original sentence indicates a present wish.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "May I speak with the manager?" he said. 
 
 
• Changes the sentence into a question, altering the original statement format.
 
 
</ul
